metadata.regulation: CBN AML/CFT Regulations 2022 & Consumer Protection Regulations 2019

clauses.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
clauses.summary: Financial institutions must identify and verify customers using BVN, NIN, or international passport before establishing business relationships. Risk-based CDD procedures must be implemented.
clauses.penalty_info: Penalties may include fines up to ₦10,000,000 or suspension of license

clauses.title: Transaction Monitoring & PEP Screening
clauses.summary: Real-time transaction monitoring required to detect suspicious activities. Customers must be screened against PEP lists with enhanced due diligence.
clauses.penalty_info: Non-compliance may result in regulatory sanctions and fines

clauses.title: Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR)
clauses.summary: STR must be filed with NFIU within 24 hours of forming suspicion. Staff who report in good faith are protected by law.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to file STR within 24 hours may result in significant penalties

clauses.title: Enterprise-wide AML Risk Assessment
clauses.summary: Annual AML risk assessment covering products, services, customers, and geographic locations. Methodology and findings must be documented.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to conduct annual risk assessment may result in enforcement

clauses.title: Annual AML/CFT Training
clauses.summary: All employees including board and management must receive annual AML/CFT training covering recent regulations and emerging risks.
clauses.penalty_info: Inadequate training may be considered a compliance failure

clauses.title: Record Keeping Requirements
clauses.summary: Transaction records and customer identification documents must be retained for at least 5 years after account closure.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to maintain proper records may result in penalties

clauses.title: Independent AML Compliance Audit
clauses.summary: Annual independent AML compliance audit by internal or external qualified party assessing compliance with AML/CFT obligations.
clauses.penalty_info: Lack of independent audit may be considered a compliance gap

clauses.title: AML Compliance Officer
clauses.summary: Designated AML/CFT Compliance Officer at senior management level must oversee all compliance including STR reporting to NFIU.
clauses.penalty_info: Failure to appoint compliance officer may result in regulatory action

clauses.title: Consumer Data Privacy
clauses.summary: Financial service providers must protect consumer privacy, not disclose information without consent, and comply with data protection laws.
clauses.penalty_info: Violation of consumer privacy triggers enforcement
